base_versions.base_sprite_sheets: 3 original user-provided sheets (8+6+6 poses), distributed separately
base_versions.generated_candidates: 3 generated v0.1 RGBA candidates; not accepted
base_versions.provisional_generated_batch: 9 additional RGBA PNG candidate frames across AS-01/02/03; preserved in owner library as standalone ZIP; not user accepted

license_policy.public_binary_distribution: not automatic; explicit user approval needed

stages.title: 基线审查与角色一致性锁定
outputs: role identity/style lock and source/provenance hashes
user review of M1 selected poses
stages.acceptance: All 32 inventoried, original/derivative assets distinguished, M1 relevant poses reviewed for animation cropping/anchor consistency; unreviewed M2 art does not block the GIF builder/playback proof.

stages.title: WAIT_USER 举 NEED HELP 牌
stages.acceptance: Sign is legible (or empty and text overlaid correctly), clear human-help semantics at 160–240px; user approved.

stages.title: ERROR/BLOCKED 趴卧分层
stages.acceptance: Prone pose, correct anatomy, differentiated blocked/error, no gore, full sprite transparency; user approved.

stages.title: COMPLETE 空中盘旋举√牌
stages.acceptance: Correct check sign, coherent wings/limbs/flight sequence, parent-task completion only; user approved.

stages.title: THINKING/RECOVERING 推理与诊断
stages.acceptance: Clearly active automatic diagnosis, not WAIT_USER or ERROR; user approved.

stages.title: IDLE/WORKING/AUTO_WAIT 复用覆盖
stages.acceptance: 20 original poses individually indexed; stable anchors, no excessive motion during polling; user approved.

stages.title: PAUSED/DISCONNECTED 清晰区分
stages.acceptance: Sleep vs stale connection visibly distinct; never represent stale data as live; user approved.

stages.title: 关键过渡与有限补帧
stages.acceptance: 128/192/256px previews show no crop/jump/artifact and transitions can be preempted by WAIT_USER; user approved.

stages.title: Sprite Pack v0.2 封装与视觉验收
stages.acceptance: True PNG hashes, per-pose anchors, attribution, fallbacks and final user signoff; application integration separate.

done_definition: All stages accepted with user review, verified files/hashes/licenses, contact sheets and manifest. Source app v0.0.1 is not silently changed.

execution_policy.focus: First five groups: IDLE, WORKING, WAIT_USER, ERROR, COMPLETE. Continue other art groups independently after their own review.
execution_policy.initial_inventory: 20 original poses plus 12 derivative candidates = 32 poses
